title: Kivotos Shopping List
description: A small shopping list web app I built on my own while learning web development through Scrimba's free course. You type an item, add it to the list, and it is saved to a Firebase database. I themed it myself. It shows where I started, as a self-taught beginner, before the projects above. The last update was June 17, 2024.
objectives: Learn HTML, CSS, and JavaScript by building a complete app, following Scrimba's free course.
Learn the basics of saving data with Firebase.
myRole: Built the whole thing myself, following and then customizing the course project.
output: Version 1.1 added sound effects and improved functionality. Adding new items is currently broken on the Firebase side, so the portfolio shows screenshots.
